comment: The known breaches of the action-bar guard (action-bar.test.ts, UX-71). A RATCHET: the list only shrinks. Each entry: file, kind (outside: a primary button outside <ActionBar primary={...}>; many: more than one primary in the bar) and count. Remove an entry (or lower its count) when the screen uses the bar; the guard fails if a listed breach is gone but still listed, and for any breach not listed. Never add an entry or raise a count.
